segments.normalizedSource: ```swift let updatedModel = updateContext.model let fileManager = FileManager.default do { // Create a directory for the updated model. try fileManager.createDirectory(at: tempUpdatedModelURL, withIntermediateDirectories: true, attributes: nil) // Save the updated model to temporary filename. try updatedModel.write(to: tempUpdatedModelURL) // Replace any previously updated model with this one. _ = try fileManager.replaceItemAt(updatedModelURL, withItemAt: tempUpdatedModelURL) print("Updated model saved to:\n\t\(updatedModelURL)") } catch let error { print("Could not save updated model to the file system: \(error)") return } ```
